answer: Rising work cost schedule: every identity accumulates routing weight by completing nonrefundable verification work; base weight costs five CPU-minutes, and each shared funding source adds a 0.5 CPU-minute surcharge to the next identity. The raven checks each work receipt and applies the surcharge dynamically. By dawn, an attacker with 10,000 identities from one source pays about 417,000 CPU-hours for equivalent routing weight. A public atlas records funding links so the surcharge follows reused sources.
